common_prompt: Create one standalone semantic HTML5 document with a title, viewport meta tag, html lang, main landmark, and h1. Use the supplied framework CSS only; no JavaScript, external CDN assets, placeholder links, or invented application behavior. Every form must have explicit method/action and labeled inputs. Include every required phrase exactly. Do not invent other styling APIs.

framework_setup.syntyr: Use Syntyr CSS source v0.3.0-alpha.5, with a linked local syntyr.core.css (and optional modules for documented classes), syn-root scope and documented syn-* selectors only.
framework_setup.tailwind: Use Tailwind v4 with a linked local tailwind.css. Build only with documented utility classes; CSS compilation will be checked separately.
framework_setup.daisyui: Use daisyUI v5 with its Tailwind v4 plugin and a linked local daisyui.css. Prefer idiomatic semantic component classes and documented Tailwind utilities.

cases.prompt: Design a SaaS overview dashboard with summary metrics and a recent activity list.
Design a customer directory with a search form and a labeled data table.
Design a marketing landing-page hero, feature cards, and real links to plans/contact routes.
Design a three-tier pricing comparison with named plan cards and links to plan routes.
Design a profile settings form with name/email fields, a submit button and a real POST endpoint.
Design a billing overview with a captioned invoice table and payment status labels.
Design three service status panels for healthy, warning and unavailable operations.
Design an application workspace with accessible navigation and main content cards.
Design a first-use checklist with an ordered set of account onboarding steps.
Design a notifications preferences form with labeled native checkboxes and save button.
